target_customer: Independent wealth management and financial advice firms, mainly in the UK
problem: Advice firms spend large amounts of adviser time on admin, reports, suitability letters and compliance checks. Saturn automates this with AI so each adviser can serve more clients.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for advice firms
product_category: AI operating system for wealth management compliance and back office

founders.name: Amal Jolly
founders.background_notes: YC page cites product and go to market experience across banking, insurance, wealth and asset management and capital markets technology.

founders.name: Michael Ettlinger
founders.background_notes: AI research background, working on AI agents since 2017, per YC page.

founders.name: Rohit Vaish
founders.background_notes: Over five years building portfolios for wealth firms at BNY Mellon, per YC page.

competitors.name: Paradino
competitors.what: Turns meeting recordings into file notes and paraplanning requests

competitors.name: Guideway
competitors.what: AI paraplanning avatar and file noting tool for Australian advisers
competitors.traction_then: Claimed about 45 minutes saved per client meeting

technical_complexity.rationale: Applying LLMs to regulated advice documents needs integrations with many advice and back office platforms and compliance checks, but the underlying models were available off the shelf in 2024.

defensibility.rationale: Two way integrations with each firm's back office and compliance workflows create switching costs, but several AI paraplanning tools launched in the same period.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent acquisition or copy was found in the sources through 2025-10.

market_need_then: UK advice firms face high cost to serve, adviser shortages and regulatory pressure. The founders cite an advice gap and the company says it reached cashflow positive in its second month in market.

branding.domain_note: Uses saturnos.com, not saturn.com. The name collides with the defunct car brand and the planet in search.

identity.visual_style: Refreshed in 2025 with a focus on human stories
identity.voice_and_tone: Positions around human led advice made accessible

rebrands.why: CEO quoted saying the refresh commits to telling the human stories technology enables, as client numbers doubled in three months

brand_strength.rationale: Sources show a brand refresh and trade press coverage of the raise, but nothing on community or word of mouth beyond customer testimonials.

outcome_analysis: Saturn is active and grew fast: its site claims 500 plus advice firms and the October 2025 press release 600 plus, and it raised a $15M Series A led by Singular. The company cites cashflow positive status in its second month. Success factors are early product market fit with advice firms, the generative AI tailwind and a repeatable firm by firm sales motion. Final outcome is not yet known.
notes: Series A reported as about 15M USD, 12.9M EUR or 11.3M GBP depending on outlet; recorded as 15M USD. No seed or pre-seed round found. One outlet names a different lead and founders and a French outlet says founded 2022; both treated as unreliable. Customer counts differ (200 firms on YC page, 500 plus on site, 600 plus in press). Competitors listed are Australian and UK era AI paraplanning tools dated near the 2024 batch; no UK specific competitor with a dated source was found. Removed undated or late competitors (Paraplanner.ai) to keep the list contemporaneous.
